summary_md:
# Orderböckerna är fyllda – nu växlar försvarsbolagen upp

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode (EFN Börslunch, 3 Sep 2026) looks at European defence stocks. Order books are very strong, but production capacity is the bottleneck, and after a strong January peak the sector has been volatile and weaker. Guests Joakim Agerback (Finserv) and Tom Ganshär (Pareto) argue that defence demand will keep growing for years. They point to the beaten-down Rheinmetall valuation, Saab's technology leadership and especially small-cap suppliers and contract manufacturers (MilDef, Note, Hanza, Clavister) as opportunities. A Yubico guest covers cybersecurity as part of national defence.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RHM — Rheinmetall | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down ~50%; guest (Agerback) finds the current valuation plus strong position interesting.

#### Reasoning

Guest Joakim Agerback says Rheinmetall becomes interesting after a ~50% drawdown given its strong long-term position in European rearmament. Risks remain: failing to deliver on megaprograms and capacity constraints delaying cash flows.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued failure to deliver on megaprogram orders
- margin erosion from capacity build-out costs
- ceasefire reducing defence urgency

> *"Rheinmetalls läge med nuvarande värdering och deras starka förutsättning, så blir de intresserade"*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Capacity build-out beats expectations; Pareto guest sees Saab staying a tech leader in European defence.

#### Reasoning

Both guests praise Saab's execution: Karlskoga expansion is faster than expected, it has repeatedly beaten expectations, and it has diversified production (Brazil). Tom Ganshär sees it staying a tech leader but prefers beaten-down small caps for upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- capacity bottlenecks delaying deliveries
- local-production requirements eroding margins

> *"Saab tror jag fortfarande kommer vara teknikledare, en väldigt viktig del av Europas försvar."*

---

### 🟢 MILDEF — MilDef | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Pareto guest singles out MilDef among punished defence small caps with broad exposure.

#### Reasoning

Tom Ganshär says small-cap defence names have been punished most and suggests looking there, naming MilDef for broad defence exposure not tied to a single prime. Joakim Agerback cites MilDef's role in BAE Systems' system sales as an example of strategic-partnership volume.

#### Sell Triggers

- loss of BAE Systems partnership volumes
- defence budget delays

> *"Det finns bolag som ett Astor Group till exempel, Mildev som du nämnde också. De har en väldigt bred exponering mot försvarsindustrin."*

---

### 🟢 NOTE — Note | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

New 160 MSEK defence order; defence exposure growing fast; named as an indirect defence play.

#### Reasoning

Note's defence exposure is growing faster than its other sectors, and it just won a 160 MSEK three-year order. The Pareto guest lists contract manufacturers like Note as a way to own defence growth with more stability than single-product companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- slowing defence order intake
- margin pressure in EMS

> *"Sen har du kontraktstillverkarna. Du har Note, Hansa, hela det."*

---

### 🟢 HANZA — Hanza | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Contract manufacturer named by the Pareto guest as a way to get defence exposure.

#### Reasoning

Tom Ganshär names Hanza alongside Note as contract manufacturers benefiting from defence growth. Subcontractors offer stability but lower valuations than single-product companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- defence demand not converting into orders for subcontractors

> *"Sen har du kontraktstillverkarna. Du har Note, Hansa, hela det."*

---

### 🟠 CLAV — Clavister | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Included in BAE Systems' large system deals, as an example of a small company in a strategic partnership.

#### Reasoning

Joakim Agerback suggests looking further down the supply chain at companies inside large strategic partnerships, using Clavister's inclusion in BAE Systems' offerings as the example.

#### Sell Triggers

- loss of the BAE partnership

> *"Här i Sverige har vi det vanliga exemplet att Mildef och Clavister ingår i att BA Systems säljer stora system"*

---

### 🟠 THEON — Theon International | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Greek company (heard as 'Zion') named as a key sub-component in autonomous and command-and-control systems in Europe.

#### Reasoning

Joakim Agerback suggests looking below the primes at component suppliers such as the Greek company, as Europe moves toward autonomous and new command-and-control systems.

#### Sell Triggers

- slower European adoption of autonomous systems

> *"Man kan titta på ett grekiskt Zion eller nåt liknande som blir som en viktig delkomponent"*

---

### 🟡 SNOW — Snowflake | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited: Inge Heydorn owns a small position; benefits from AI data structuring, but the valuation is aggressive.

#### Reasoning

Cited opinion from Inge Heydorn (EFN Morgon): Snowflake benefits as companies structure data for AI models, but the fund keeps the position small because the valuation assumes success.

#### Sell Triggers

- failure to execute on AI data demand
- valuation compression

> *"Vi äger Snowflake, men har inte en jättestor position för värderingen är ganska aggressiv."*

---
